summary: Iteration 30 FULL PASS (backend 16/16 pytest + all 6 frontend feature groups verified end-to-end at 390x844 web preview). BACKEND (backend_iteration30_test.py, ~4.6s): (1) Privacy: GET /api/legal/privacy-policy is public (200, returns version/updated/content > 100 chars); GET /api/legal/consent returns 401 without Bearer; POST /api/legal/consent/accept for owner → accepted:true w/ ISO accepted_at + version matches current_version; subsequent GET shows accepted:true + requires_acceptance:false; TEST_DEMO_EMAIL also accepts successfully. (2) /api/billing/limits: owner tier=pro w/ limits:null + numeric usage (clients=1, invoices_this_month=1, ai_this_month=0 at test time); demo tier=free w/ exact limits {clients:2, invoices_per_month:3, ai_per_month:10} + int usage counters. (3) Free tier enforcement on demo: created clients up to 2 → 3rd returns HTTP 402 body containing 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED:clients:2'; created invoices up to 3 (this month) → 4th returns HTTP 402 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED:invoices:3'; POST /api/ai/ndis-assistant increments ai_this_month by exactly 1 (verified via before/after /billing/limits diff). All test clients + invoices then DELETED — usage back to ≤ limits. (4) Owner pro can create invoices freely (no 402); POST /api/invoices/{id}/items appends line correctly and recomputes totals: 1st item $50 gst_free → subtotal/gst/total 50/0/50; appended 65.47 gst_free → new subtotal 115.47, gst 0.00, total 115.47; GET /api/invoices/{id} confirms 2 items persisted. (5) Regression: mixed gst_free invoice (2×67.56 gst-free + 50 non-gst-free) → subtotal 185.12, gst 5.00, total 190.12, ttp true, per-item service_date/start_time/end_time all round-trip; tasks CRUD (POST /tasks + GET ?date + PATCH + DELETE); client with next_of_kin dict persists + returns via GET. FRONTEND (390x844 owner login, onboarding skipped): (A) Login: owner TEST_USER / TEST_PASSWORD → because owner had already accepted consent via test API call, the consent screen did NOT re-appear (matches spec — re-login should NOT show consent again). Dashboard loads with 33+ testIDs incl. dashboard-screen, quick-invoice, tool-account, tool-membership. (B) Account → Privacy Policy row (account-privacy-policy) navigates to /privacy-policy screen (privacy-policy-screen), green banner 'You accepted this policy on 08/07/2026' visible (consent-accepted-row PRESENT), full policy text renders (Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) + APPs + full sections). (C) Account → Alert sound row navigates to /alert-sound (alert-sound-screen); all 4 radios PRESENT (sound-default, sound-chime, sound-bell, sound-pulse); tapping Chime does NOT crash — screen stays alive (native-only playback correctly no-ops on web, no red screen). (D) Planner Day/Week/Month segmented control (view-day/view-week/view-month all PRESENT). Created plan for today (add-task-fab → title 'TEST_it30 shift' + time 09:00 + type-shift + save-task-btn) — Day view shows task, no crash despite alarms being native-only. Switched to Week: week-view rendered with 7 rows Mon–Sun (6 July–12 July), today's row (Wed 8) shows '1 shift' chip + '09:00 · TEST_it30 shift' preview line, week-prev/week-next present, week-day-2026-07-08 selector resolves. Switched to Month: month-view calendar grid rendered (July 2026), month-day-2026-07-08 has count badge '1' + brand border highlight; month-summary reads 'THIS MONTH 1 shift 0/1 done'; month-prev/month-next PRESENT. Tapping today's month cell returns to Day view with the task still visible. Cleaned up via del-task-<id> UI button — task removed. (E) Assistant attach flow (/assistant): sent 'what code for 2 hours of personal care on a weekday' → LLM replied w/ 01_011_0107_1_1 chip (use-code-01_011_0107_1_1); tapping the chip opened attach-sheet with 'New invoice' (attach-new-invoice) row PLUS the existing draft INV-1010 as attach-inv-<id> row; tapped the draft row → item appended (verified via API: INV-1010 items went 1→2, total $200.00→$267.56, exactly +$67.56 = the assistant's suggested rate). (F) Membership screen (/membership via tool-membership) renders membership-screen + membership-status + 'Free 14-day trial' status card + both Pro plans (Monthly $19.99, Yearly $199). (G) OfflineBanner: [data-testid="offline-banner"] does NOT appear during normal browsing — probe-based checkOnline behaves correctly. No React Native red-screen errors observed. Console warnings limited to pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations + expo-notifications web-not-supported notice (unchanged from iter29). Deprecated packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports found in code — all clean.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:281 GET /legal/privacy-policy has no auth dependency — verified public (200 without token).
server.py:287 GET /legal/consent requires get_current_user — 401 without token verified.

server.py:303 POST /legal/consent/accept sets server-side datetime.now(timezone.utc), stored on users doc; ISO string returned to client. Timestamp cannot be spoofed by client — correct compliance behaviour.
server.py:312 FREE_LIMITS constant {clients:2, invoices_per_month:3, ai_per_month:10} matches spec exactly.
server.py:344/351 _enforce_client_limit uses count_documents on clients (org-scoped); _enforce_invoice_limit uses month prefix regex on created_at — correctly gates per-month.

server.py:358 _consume_ai increments AFTER the limit check, using upsert on db.ai_usage keyed by (org_id, month=YYYY-MM). Any of the 5 AI endpoints that calls _consume_ai will consume 1 unit — verified for /ai/ndis-assistant (before/after diff = 1).
server.py:965 POST /invoices/{id}/items reuses InvoiceItem shape, calls compute_invoice_totals, persists atomically with $set. Return goes through doc_out which strips _id — no ObjectId leakage.
server.py:3062 /billing/limits owner uses _is_pro(user) — trialing/lifetime/paid all count as pro (unlimited); free path returns FREE_LIMITS. Usage counts always populated.

Frontend consent gate — because /legal/consent is now a hard gate before onboarding, the AuthContext + _layout logic correctly hides the gate after acceptance (verified: post-accept re-login skips consent-screen straight to onboarding/dashboard).

Frontend UpgradeSheet — although not exercised via UI in this run (owner is pro), the backend 402 payloads follow the exact 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED:<feature>:<limit>' shape the frontend parser expects, so the modal will trigger correctly for free-tier users.
